source: OpenStreetMap ways (amenity=parking) inside the Town of Antigonish, fetched 2026-10-25; grouping reviewed by John 2026-10-25.

properties.name: Sydney Street Lot
properties.description: Town parking lot, about 40 spaces. Lot outline from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors). Rates and rules from the Town of Antigonish parking page (October 2026).
properties.card_html:
Town parking lot, about 40 spaces.

Paid Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.: $0.50 an hour, 2 hours maximum. Enter your licence plate and pay at the kiosk (cash, debit or credit).

Overnight parking is allowed May 1 to November 30 (move your car by 7 a.m.). From December 1 to April 30 the winter parking ban applies: no parking from 12 a.m. to 7 a.m.

Lot outline from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors). Rates and rules from the Town of Antigonish parking page (October 2026).

properties.name: Creighton Lane Lot
properties.description: Town parking lot by Brierly Brook, about 150 spaces. Lot outline from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors). Rates and rules from the Town of Antigonish parking page (October 2026).
properties.card_html:
Town parking lot by Brierly Brook, about 150 spaces.

The middle rows are paid Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.: $0.50 an hour, 3 hours maximum, pay at the kiosk. The spaces around the edge are free. Accessible spaces are at the Creighton Lane end.

Overnight parking is allowed May 1 to November 30 (move your car by 7 a.m.). From December 1 to April 30 the winter parking ban applies: no parking from 12 a.m. to 7 a.m.

Lot outline from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors). Rates and rules from the Town of Antigonish parking page (October 2026).
